intro: Tirisfal Pumpkins grow in the tilled plots of the Solliden Farmstead, tended by surviving living humans struggling to survive in the blighted glades. The Forsaken routinely raid these fields to supply the Royal Apothecary Society with organic matter for their ongoing chemical concoctions.

p: Despite the corruption settling over Lordaeron, crops still somehow sprout in the fields west of Brill. At the Solliden Farmstead, living human farmers cling to their soil, cultivating massive orange squash under the watchful guard of the nearby Scarlet Crusade. For these mortals, the harvest is vital sustenance. For the nearby Forsaken of Brill, however, the pumpkins represent both a spiteful target of sabotage and a bounty of raw organic reagents needed by Apothecary Johaan.

Deathguard Simmer directs young Forsaken out into the contested fields to pilfer the pumpkins directly from beneath the farmers' noses. Rather than feeding the dead, these vegetables find their way into the boiling cauldrons of the Royal Apothecary Society. The apothecaries frequently test how natural flora reacts to their plagues and experimental mixtures, turning Lordaeron's remaining agriculture against the living.
